summary.name: GPTDiscord
summary.one_liner: GPTDiscord is an open-source Python integration that brings GPT conversations, image generation and document questions into Discord.
use_cases: Run GPT chat conversations inside a Discord server
Ask questions about uploaded documents in Discord
Add AI features to a community server
Self-host a Python Discord bot powered by OpenAI
summary.what_it_does: The page describes GPTDiscord as an open-source Python integration that connects GPT-based conversations, image generation and document question answering to Discord. It is listed on the author's personal site (kaveenk.com) and in the e2b-dev awesome-ai-agents list, which describes the author as the founder of GPT Discord. The page itself is a portfolio page and gives no setup steps, configuration details, pricing or feature list beyond that one-line description.
notable: Brings GPT chat, image generation and document Q&A into Discord
Created by Kaveen Kumarasinghe, listed on his personal site
caveats: The page gives no detail on hosting requirements, API key or OpenAI costs
Page is a portfolio listing with limited technical detail
